verified.exploit: On any CurveInterface.V2 vault whose Curve coin is the WETH ERC-20 (the standard crypto-v2 layout), _exitPool hardcodes use_eth=true so the pool unwraps and pushes native ETH, but the re-wrap in unstakeAndExitPool only fires when TOKEN_i == ETH_ADDRESS, so the vault treats the native ETH it received as an increase in its WETH balance — the two-sided delta tokenBalance(TOKEN_1) - before reads 0 and the redeemer is credited nothing while the ETH is stranded, and the single-sided path credits an amount of asset=WETH the vault never received and pays it out of other users' WETH until redemptions revert.

verified.reason: For a CurveInterface.V2 crypto pool the coin address returned by coins(i) is the WETH ERC-20 (not ALT_ETH), so _rewriteAltETH leaves TOKEN_i == WETH and the ETH_ADDRESS-gated WETH.deposit re-wrap in unstakeAndExitPool never fires, yet _exitPool passes the hardcoded use_eth=true to both remove_liquidity_one_coin and remove_liquidity, which makes the pool unwrap and push native ETH to the vault — leaving the two-sided delta tokenBalance(WETH)-before at 0 and the single-sided branch crediting a WETH amount the vault never actually received.
